correctness.rationale: Explicit face-plane projections give the globally positive p,q map; algebraic substitutions give exact T and the first integral H and area-form Jacobian. The sum-of-squares formula proves the unique maximum. The quadratic discriminant has two simple positive roots for every 0<c<1/3, proving a single smooth compact level oval. Coarea disintegration of the positive invariant area form gives a positive invariant level measure, hence conjugacy to a circle translation. Short-period exclusion follows from the symmetric second-order recurrence. Elliptic linearization with non-root-of-unity eigenangles and continuous rotation numbers yields dense orbits arbitrarily near the fixed point. Finite exact Fraction checks (3712) supplement, rather than substitute for, these universal arguments.

value.rationale: The paper gives a natural failure of planar n-step pedal return in space, but one example cannot tell whether generic spatial shapes converge, cycle, or vary chaotically. This result completely classifies the axial symmetric family by a nontrivial conserved geometric parameter and rigid-rotation dynamics, showing all normalized orbits bounded, no short returns, and dense nonperiodic shape orbits arbitrarily close to the centered regular case. The fixed-center all-parameter dichotomy is a structural answer rather than a routine numeric extension.
